founder: Tobias Günther and Alexander Rinass (co-founders, Fournova, Germany)

currentUserWorkflow: Devs memorize CLI commands or wrestle with clunky free GUIs; teams struggle onboarding non-experts onto Git.
productSolution: Fast native Mac/Windows Git client with drag-and-drop, undo, conflict wizard and pull-request workflows.

featuresNotInMVP: Windows version, pull-request management, stacked branches, AI commits, team management, SSO.

secondaryDistribution: Partnerships (Perforce/GitSwarm bundling 2015), word of mouth in dev teams, review/comparison pages.

productHuntStrategy: No notable Product Hunt launch found.

techStack: Native per platform: Objective-C/Swift plus Apple frameworks (Mac); C#/WPF/.NET (Windows).
infrastructure: Desktop apps plus licensing/billing backend (Paddle merchant-of-record); detail NOT PUBLIC.
aiUsage: AI commit-message generation in current versions; no AI at founding.
devMethod: Bootstrapped small team; moved from big-bang major releases to frequent small releases.

competitors: GitKraken, SourceTree, GitHub Desktop, Fork, Sublime Merge, SmartGit.
competitiveWeaknesses: Subscription-only licensing caused rent-vs-own backlash; crowded market with strong free clients; post-acquisition indie-trust questions.

founder: Randy Schmidt (original solo builder); acquired by Collective Idea (Daniel Morrison) July 2013

coreProblem: Silent failures: cron jobs that do not run produce no output, so nobody notices missed backups or emails.
problemFrequency: Ongoing: every scheduled interval is a chance for silent failure.
problemSeverity: HIGH: missed backups/billing jobs can be business-critical.
existingAlternatives: Cron email output, Healthchecks.io, Cronitor, self-built ping scripts.

currentFeatureSet: Basic/enhanced intervals, Smart Alerts, error notices plus logs via Field Agent, API, integrations, unlimited team members.

secondaryDistribution: Consultancy dogfooding/referrals, word of mouth, developer goodwill.

productHuntStrategy: No notable Product Hunt launch found.
partnerships: Heroku add-on partnership (hourly billing via Heroku).
referralViral: Low virality; unlimited team members aids in-company spread.
techStack: Ruby API client (Snitcher gem); backend stack NOT PUBLIC (GitHub org shows Go/Ruby/Shell tooling).
infrastructure: Ping ingestion at deadmanssnitch.com/nosnch.in; detail NOT PUBLIC.
devMethod: Consultancy-subsidized product: agency team maintains it alongside client work.
soloFeasibility: YES: originated as a solo side project; Healthchecks.io proves solo operation.
differentiation: Most focused dead-simple cron monitor; Field Agent error logs; Heroku-native billing.
competitiveMoat: LOW: trivially clonable concept; longevity plus reliability reputation.
competitors: Healthchecks.io (open source), Cronitor, UptimeRobot, Sentry Cron.
